post.description:
Creates a draft, or schedules it if you set `schedule`, `schedule_now` or `queue` (which also needs at least one account). Each line of `body` becomes a paragraph.

**Required permission:** `publishing:posts:write`, plus `publishing:posts:publish` to schedule, queue or publish now.

put.description:
Replaces the post's accounts, tags, date, time and versions. `date` and `time` use the workspace's timezone. To schedule, call [Schedule a post](/publishing/posts/schedule-a-post) afterwards. A non-draft post with no accounts or no date and time goes back to draft.

**Required permission:** `publishing:posts:write`, plus `publishing:posts:publish` if the post is scheduled or you send a `date` and `time`.
